const $base64alpha = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
const $hexalpha = "01234567890ABCDEF"

;Thanks to Hyryel for giving me the idea to use find and providing a code snippet
;reads a base64 letter and converts it into the binary representation
function @b64($letter:text):text
	var $idx = find($base64alpha, $letter)
	var $result = 0
	var $rest = 0
	
	var $i = 0
	while $idx > 0
		$rest = $idx % 2
		$idx = ($idx-$rest) / 2
		$result += $rest*(10^$i)
		$i++
	return text("{000000}", $result)

;Takes a between 0 and 16 and converts to the Hex value using the lookup table
function @tohex($value:number):text
	return $hexalpha.$value

const $numbers = "0123456789"

function @hsv_to_color($h:number, $s:number, $v:number):number
	if $s == 0
		return color($v * 255, $v * 255, $v * 255);No Saturation meaens the color is just grey of V

	var $i = floor($h * 6)
	var $f = ($h * 6) - $i
	var $p = $v * (1 - $s)
	var $q = $v * (1 - ($s * $f))
	var $t = $v * (1 - ($s * (1 - $f)))

	if $i < 1
		return color($v * 255, $t * 255, $p * 255)
	elseif $i < 2
		return color($q * 255, $v * 255, $p * 255)
	elseif $i < 3
		return color($p * 255, $v * 255, $t * 255)
	elseif $i < 4
		return color($p * 255, $q * 255, $v * 255)
	elseif $i < 5
		return color($t * 255, $p * 255, $v * 255)
	else
		return color($v * 255, $p * 255, $q * 255)



var $text_pos = 0
function @write_center($color:number, $txt:text)
	var $size = size($txt) * char_w
	write((screen_w * 0.5) - ($size * 0.5),$text_pos, $color, $txt)
	$text_pos += char_h

function @is_number($input:text):number
	return find($numbers, $input) != -1

function @get_highest_score():text
	var $arr_size = size($top_scores)
	var $highest_score = -1
	var $best_name = ""
	repeat $arr_size ($i)
		var $raw = $top_scores.$i
		var $score = $raw.score:number
		if $score > $highest_score
			$highest_score = $score
			$best_name = $raw.name
	return ".name{" & $best_name & "}.score{" & $highest_score:text & "}"

;Returns 0 if it's not a top score or 1 if it is, basically has to be in the top-10
function @check_score_is_top():number
	var $better_scores = 0
	var $arr_size = size($top_scores)
	repeat $arr_size ($i)
		var $raw = $top_scores.$i
		var $score = $raw.score:number
		if $score >= $current_score
			$better_scores += 1
	return $better_scores < 10

xc_files.plain_code:
include "base64lookup.xc"
;This is a base64 representation of a 4 bpp bitmap file saying SpaceInvaders
const $si_logo = ""

;Populated after calling decode_title
;Contains the entire data decoded into 4 bit values (0 to 16)
array $title_nibbles:number
;image size
var $title_width:number
var $title_height:number
;Bits per pixel must be 4!
var $title_bpp:number

;Offset into data where pixels start, not sure why I can't figure out how to do this using the header information seems wrong
;The offset is thre nibble coordinate
var $title_pix_start = 396;

;This is the palette read from the bitmap
array $title_colors:number


;private function
;Gets a byte (8 bit value) at the byte coordinate
function @_get_byte_value($byte_pos:number):number
	;Convert to nibble coordinate and read both values
	$byte_pos *= 2
	var $nib1 = $title_nibbles.$byte_pos
	$byte_pos += 1
	var $nib2 = $title_nibbles.$byte_pos
	return $nib1 * 16 + $nib2


;private function
;Appends the binary into the nibbles as the value of each set of 4 bits
function @_read_binary($bin3bytes:text)
	var $text_size = size($bin3bytes)
	var $number = 0;index into binary array
	var $bit = 3   ;bit index for the current 4 bit value
	var $index = 0
	var $char = $bin3bytes.0
	while 1
		$number += ($char)*(2^($bit))
		$index += 1
		$bit -= 1
		if $index < $text_size
			$char = $bin3bytes.$index
		else
			$title_nibbles.append($number);
			break
		if $index % 4 == 0
			$bit = 3
			$title_nibbles.append($number);
			$number = 0

;Converts the base64 into the binary data and stores as 4 bit nibbles in $title_nibbles
function @decode_title()
	var $pos = 0
	var $size = size($si_logo)
	var $byte_pos = 0
	while $pos < $size
		var $bin3bytes = ""
		repeat 4 ($i);4 characters = 3 bytes
			var $char = $si_logo.$pos
			$bin3bytes &= @b64($char)
			$pos += 1

		$byte_pos += 3
		@_read_binary($bin3bytes )
		

	$title_width = @_get_byte_value(18)
	$title_height = @_get_byte_value(22)
	$title_bpp = @_get_byte_value(28)
	
	if $title_bpp != 4
		print("Image file does not have 4 bits per pixel, image will be corrupt")
	
	;Read palette
	$pos = 142
	$title_colors.clear()
	$title_colors.append(black);idk why it's not pulling the first value from the color pallet, but I'm tired lol
	repeat 16 ($c_index)
		var $b_pos = $pos + ($c_index * 4)
		var $g_pos = $pos + ($c_index * 4) + 1
		var $r_pos = $pos + ($c_index * 4) + 2
		var $r = @_get_byte_value($r_pos)
		var $g = @_get_byte_value($g_pos)
		var $b = @_get_byte_value($b_pos)
		$title_colors.append(color($r,$g,$b))
	

;Draws the title with top-left at specified coordinates
function @draw_title($x:number, $y:number)
	repeat $title_height ($py)
		repeat $title_width ($px)
			var $pos = $title_pix_start + ($px + ($py * $title_width));
			if ($pos >= size($title_nibbles))
				return

			var $palette = $title_nibbles.$pos
			var $value = $title_colors.$palette
			draw_point($x + $px, $y + ($title_height - $py), $value)

;Draws the title with the center at the specified coordinates
function @draw_title_centered($x:number, $y:number)
	$x -= $title_width / 2
	$y -= $title_height / 2
	@draw_title($x,$y)

;This file contains the destructable objects (the 4 green hill looking thingies)
const $destructable_size = 26
const $destructable_count = 4
const $destructble_carve_radius = 6
const $corner_dist = 4
const $destructable_ypos = 110
const $destructable_spacing = 1.5
var $destructable_color = color(0,64,0)
const $destructable_explosion_radius = 4


array $destructables:text

;Generates a destructable object bit by bit
function @_generate_destructable()
	var $buffer = ""
	;We use the square to save doing a sqrt everytime, idk probably pointless, but all the IPC I can save the better
	var $radsqr = $destructble_carve_radius * $destructble_carve_radius
	var $carve_x = ($destructable_size * 0.5)
	var $carve_y = $destructable_size
	repeat $destructable_size ($x)
		var $cx = $x - $carve_x
		repeat $destructable_size ($y)
			var $cy = $y - $carve_y
			;carve out the circle in the bottom
			var $do_carve = $cx * $cx + $cy * $cy < $radsqr
			if $do_carve
				$buffer &= "0"
			else
				;Finally check the corners
				var $corner_amount = min(max($x + $y,$y + $x),max(($destructable_Size - $x) + $y,$y + ($destructable_Size - $x)))
				if $corner_amount < $corner_dist
					$buffer &= "0"
				else
					$buffer &= "1"
	$destructables.append($buffer)

;Generates all the destructables, ready for blasting
function @init_destructables()
	$destructables.clear()
	repeat $destructable_count ($i)
		@_generate_destructable()

;Draws one of the destructables
function @_draw_destructable($dest_index:number, $offset_x:number,$offset_y:number)
	var $data = $destructables.$dest_index
	repeat $destructable_size ($x)
		repeat $destructable_size ($y)
			var $index = $y + $x * $destructable_size
			if $data.$index == "1"
				draw_point($x + $offset_x,$y + $offset_y, $destructable_color)

;Draws each destructable object
function @draw_destructables()
	var $y = $destructable_ypos
	repeat $destructable_count ($i)
		var $offset_index = $i - ($destructable_count * 0.5)
		var $spacing = $destructable_size * $destructable_spacing
		var $x = screen_w * 0.5 + ($offset_index * $spacing)
		@_draw_destructable($i, $x,$y)

;private function
;Inputs must be integer, destroys the pixels of this destructable within the radius specified in the constants
function @_explode($relative_x:number, $relative_y:number, $destructable_index:number):number
	var $radsqr = $destructable_explosion_radius * $destructable_explosion_radius
	var $data = $destructables.$destructable_index
	repeat $destructable_size ($x)
		var $offset_x = $relative_x - $x
		repeat $destructable_size ($y)
			var $offset_y = $relative_y - $y
			var $dist = $offset_x * $offset_x + $offset_y * $offset_y
			if $dist <= $radsqr
				var $index = $y + $x * $destructable_size
				$data.$index = "0"
	$destructables.$destructable_index = $data

;private function
;Inputs must be integer, detects collision by reading the pixel it's over
function @_per_pix_collision($relative_x:number, $relative_y:number,$destructable_index:number):number
	var $d = $destructables.$destructable_index
	var $pix_index = $relative_y + $relative_x * $destructable_size
	return $d.$pix_index:number

;Checks for and does collision based on a projectile being at the $x, $y coordinates, return 0 if no collision, 1 if there was
function @do_destruct_collision($point_x:number, $point_y:number):number
	var $y = $destructable_ypos
	repeat $destructable_count ($i)
		var $offset_index = $i - ($destructable_count * 0.5)
		var $spacing = $destructable_size * $destructable_spacing
		var $x = screen_w * 0.5 + ($offset_index * $spacing)
		if $point_x >= $x && $point_y >= $y && $point_x < $x + $destructable_size && $point_y < $y + $destructable_size
			;We're inside range of this destructable lets do per-pixel collision
			var $rel_x = floor($point_x - $x)
			var $rel_y = floor($point_y - $y)
			if @_per_pix_collision($rel_x, $rel_y,$i)
				@_explode($rel_x,$rel_y,$i)
				return 1
			
	return 0

xc_files.plain_code:
;functions starting with _ are not expected to be called from outside of the file they're declared in
;Coded by Shadoh for the Space Invaders Challenge
;Enjoy!


;Global declarations used everywhere
storage array $top_scores:text
;Set this to set the color of the light
var $light_color = blue
;Determines what screen to show
var $main_state = 0; 0 = Play intro, 1 = Waiting player, 2 = Playing, 3 = entering score
var $current_score = 0

;These values get reset when returning to the title
var $intro_sfx_played = 0
var $intro_state = 0
var $title_first_draw = 0

function @return_to_title()
	$intro_sfx_played = 0
	$intro_state = 0
	$main_state = 0
	$title_first_draw = 0

;Contains all the functions that are used through-out the project, includes the sprite drawing functions for enemies
include "space_helpers.xc"

;Contains and decodes the 'Space Invaders' title
include "title.xc"

;Handles all the sound effects
include "sfx.xc"

;Contains some test functions used during development
include "tests.xc"

;Contains the functions to allow the player to input their name for the highscores
include "name.xc"

;The core game itself and thus the biggest file (if you don't count the data in the title lol)
include "game.xc"

;The final position of the logo
const $title_top = 16
;How long the intro takes to play out
const $intro_length = 6
;Speed of sound effects in the intro
const $intro_step_rate = 0.5


var $title_entry:number;set at init for screen height
var $next_intro_step = 0


;Handles updating and drawing the intro screen
function @_intro_update() 
	blank(black)
	$intro_state += delta_time
	if $intro_state > $intro_length
		$main_state = 1
		$intro_state = 0
	
	var $brightness = $intro_state / $intro_length
	
	if $intro_state < 3
		$light_color = color($brightness,$brightness,$brightness)
	else
		var $color = mod($intro_state,10)/10
		$light_color = @hsv_to_color($color,1,$brightness)
		
	var $title_pos = clamp($intro_state / $intro_length * 1.2,0,1)
	var $inverse_pos = 1 - $title_pos
	
	var $y_pos = ($title_entry * $inverse_pos) + ($title_top * $title_pos)
	
	@draw_title_centered(screen_w/2, $y_pos)
	if $next_intro_step < 0 && $title_pos < 1
		@play_step_sfx()
		$next_intro_step = $intro_step_rate * $inverse_pos
		
	if $title_pos >= 1 && $intro_sfx_played == 0
		@play_explosion_sfx()
		$intro_sfx_played = 1
	
	$next_intro_step -= delta_time
	$title_first_draw = 0


;Handles updating and drawing the 'waiting player' screen
function @_waiting_player()
	;only blank the redrawn areas
	if $title_first_draw == 0
		blank(black)
		@draw_title_centered(screen_w/2, $title_top )
	draw_rect(0,40,screen_W,47,black,black)
	
	
	$intro_state += delta_time

	
	var $amount = 9
	var $spacing = (screen_w + 48) / $amount
	repeat $amount ($i)
		var $x = mod(($i * 26) + $intro_state * 16,screen_w + 32) - 16
		@sprite_draw_invader_ufo($x, 44, @hsv_to_color($i / $amount, 1, 1))
	if $title_first_draw == 0
		$text_pos = 50
		@write_center(white, "Top Scores")
		$text_pos += 3
		var $last_name = ""
		var $last_score = 9999999.0
		var $board_size = size($top_scores)
		repeat 8 ($i)
			var $next_name = ""
			var $next_score = -1
			repeat $board_size ($board_index)
				var $raw = $top_scores.$board_index
				var $score = $raw.score:number
				var $name = $raw.name
				if $score < $last_score && $score > $next_score
					$next_name = $name
					$next_score = $score
			if $next_score == -1
				break
			@write_center(gray,$next_name & ": " & $next_score:text)
			$text_pos += 1
			$last_name = $next_name
			$last_score = $next_score
	
	if mod($intro_state,1) > 0.5
		$text_pos = screen_h - 22
		@write_center(white,"Press SPACE to play") 
	else
		draw_rect(0,screen_h - 22,screen_W,(screen_h - 22) + char_h,black,black)
	
	if $title_first_draw == 0
		var $text = "By Shadoh"
		var $credit_width = size($text) * char_w
		write(screen_w - $credit_width,screen_h - char_h, gray, $text)
		
	if input_number(10,3) == 1
		$main_state = 2
		@setup_game()
	$title_first_draw = 1
	

init
	@decode_title()
	$main_state = 0
	$title_entry = screen_h + 44

update
	if $main_state == 0
		@_intro_update()
	
	if $main_state == 1
		@_waiting_player()
	
	if $main_state == 2
		@play_game()
		
	if $main_state == 4
		@input_player_name()
	
	if $main_state == 1337
		blank(black)
		@test_sprites()
	
	;Update light
	output_number(11,0,1);Light is pretty much just always on
	output_number(11,1,color_r($light_color))
	output_number(11,2,color_g($light_color))
	output_number(11,3,color_b($light_color))
	
	@update_sfx()

const $base_input = 4

const $music_input = 3

;Values used by the 'play' functions
var $amp_from = 0
var $amp_to = 0
var $freq_from = 0
var $freq_to = 0
var $play_duration = 0
var $random = 0
var $repeat = 0
var $step_play = 0

var $play_time = 0

;sfx_priority is used by the standard sfx buzzer to choose wether or not to play a sound
;Sounds compare the sfx value compared to the one already set, if their one is heigher the sound will be overriden
var $sfx_priority = 0

;Sets the standard sfx buzzer to play bullet sound
function @play_bullet_sfx()
	if $sfx_priority < 1
		$sfx_priority = 1
	else
		return
	$play_duration = 0.1
	$amp_from = 1
	$amp_to = 1
	$random = 1
	$freq_from = 2000
	$freq_to = 2000
	$repeat = 1

;Sets the standard sfx buzzer to play an explosion sound
function @play_explosion_sfx()
	if $sfx_priority < 2
		$sfx_priority = 2
	else
		return
	$play_duration = 0.1
	$amp_from = 1
	$amp_to = 1
	$random = 0.1
	$freq_from = 600
	$freq_to = 800
	$repeat = 3

;Uses the base buzzer to play the 'step' sound
function @play_step_sfx()
	$step_play = 1

;Stops the currently playing standard sound effect
function @stop_sfx()
	$sfx_priority = 0
	$amp_from = 0
	$amp_to = 0
	$freq_from = 0
	$freq_to = 0
	$play_duration = 0
	$play_time = 0
	$random = 0
	

;Must be called every frame to update the buzzer status
function @update_sfx()
	$volume = (input_number(9,0) + 1) * 0.5
	if $play_duration <= 0
		output_number($sfx_input,0,0)
		output_number($sfx_input,1,440)
		$sfx_priority = 0
	else
		$play_time += delta_time
		if $play_time >= $play_duration
			$repeat -= 1
			if $repeat > 0
				$play_time = 0
			else
				@stop_sfx()
		if $play_time == 0 || $play_duration == 0
			return
		var $ratio = clamp($play_time / $play_duration,0,1)
		var $iratio = 1 - $ratio
		var $amp = ($amp_from * $iratio) + ($amp_to * $ratio)
		var $freq = ($freq_from * $iratio) + ($freq_to * $ratio)
		$freq += random(100,300) * $random
		output_number($sfx_input,0,$amp * $volume)
		output_number($sfx_input,1,$freq)
	if $step_play > 0
		$step_play -= delta_time * 8
		output_number($base_input,0,$volume)
		output_number($base_input,1,50 + random(0,25))
	else
		output_number($base_input,0,0)

;instructions for players inputting name

;Alphabet available for players
var $characters = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

;Current position in the alpha bet
var $current_index = 0

;1 if button is down
var $left_button = 0
var $right_button = 0
var $up_button = 0
var $down_button = 0
var $space_button = 0

;1 If button was down last frame
var $last_left_button = 0
var $last_right_button = 0
var $last_up_button = 0
var $last_down_button = 0
var $last_space_button = 0

;Current name infput
var $name_input = ""

;1 if waiting for confirmation
var $confirm = 0

;Sets up and opens the name input
function @goto_name_input()
	$name_input = ""
	$confirm = 0
	$current_index = 0
	$main_state = 4

;private function called by input_player_name, use that to process the input
function @_input_name()
	$text_pos = 1
	@write_center(red, "Congratulations")
	@write_center(white, "You've got a high score!")
	$text_pos += 3
	@write_center(white, "Enter your name")
	$text_pos += 20
	@write_center(white, "Use W/S to select letters")
	@write_center(white, "Use A to delete")
	@write_center(white, "Use D to add")
	@write_center(white, "Space to accept")
	
	$text_pos += 10
	@write_center(white, "Your score: " & $current_score:text & "! Nice!")
	
	
	if $up_button && !$last_up_button
		$current_index -= 1
		if $current_index < 0
			$current_index = size($characters) - 1
	if $down_button && !$last_down_button
		$current_index += 1
		if $current_index >= size($characters)
			$current_index = 0
	
	var $char = $characters.$current_index
		
	if $right_button && !$last_right_button
		$name_input = $name_input & $char
		
	if $left_button && !$last_left_button
		var $new_length = size($name_input) - 1
		if $new_length <= 0
			$name_input = ""
		else
			var $old_name = $name_input
			$name_input = ""
			repeat $new_length ($i)
				$name_input &= $old_Name.$i
	
	
	
	var $text_length = size($name_input) * char_w
	write((screen_w * 0.5) - ($text_length * 0.5),34,white,$name_input)
	if mod(time,1) > 0.5
		write((screen_w * 0.5) + ($text_length * 0.5),35,white,"_")
	write((screen_w * 0.5) + ($text_length * 0.5),34,white,$char)
	
	if $space_button && !$last_space_button
		$name_input = $name_input & $char
		$confirm = 1
	
	
;private function, use input_player_name to handle input
;Asks the player if this is really their name or basically if they've accidentally hit space instead of pushing right
function @_confirm_name()
	$text_pos = 1
	@write_center(white, "Nice score " & $name_input)
	@write_center(white, "Are you sure that's your name?")
	@write_center(white, "Press 'Space' to confirm")
	@write_center(white, "or 'A' to go back")
	
	$top_scores.append(".name{" & $name_input & "}.score{" & $current_score:text & "}")
	if $space_button && !$last_space_button
		@return_to_title()
	
	if $left_button && !$last_left_button
		$confirm = 0

;Called to take player input to update name, also handles drawing
function @input_player_name()
	;Lets read the inputs
	$left_button = input_number(10,2) == -1
	$right_button = input_number(10,2) == 1
	$up_button = input_number(10,1) == 1
	$down_button = input_number(10,1) == -1
	$space_button = input_number(10,3) == 1
	blank(black)
	if $confirm == 0
		@_input_name()
	else
		@_confirm_name()
		
	$last_left_button = $left_button
	$last_right_button = $right_button
	$last_up_button = $up_button
	$last_down_button = $down_button
	$last_space_button = $space_button

const $enemy_columns = 11
const $explode_frames = 1
const $row_size = 14
const $column_size = 14
const $enemy_height_offset = 20
const $move_rate = 0.025;seconds per enemy move, can't go below 0.016 (60fps which should be what the server runs at)
const $move_amount = 3
const $game_area_limit = 10
const $bullet_speed = 100
const $bullet_explode_time = 0.2;seconds bullet spends exploding
const $death_animation_length = 1
const $enemy_size = 6
const $level_transition_time = 4
const $projectile_fire_rate = 9
const $player_width = 7;Used for bullet hit with player detection
const $ufo_chance_modifier = 0.05
const $ufo_ypos = 12
const $ufo_speed = 15
const $ufo_hit_width = 6

;UFO state, 0 = not here, 1 = flying
var $ufo_state = 0
;X position of the UFO
var $ufo_pos = 0
;Determines the score value for each enemy, each value is multiplied by 10 before applying
var $row_scores = "32211"

;X position of the player
var $player_pos:number

var $lives:number

var $level = 1

;Used for showing the goal top-right
var $highest_score = 0
var $player_to_beat = ""

;Potential states = 0 dead, 1 = anim1, 2 = anim2, 3+ = exploding
array $states:text
var $direction = 0

var $move_index = 0

;How many rows have the enemies moved down!
var $down_moves = 0

var $time_to_next_move = 0

;Bullet status
var $last_fire_button = 0
var $bullet_x = 0
var $bullet_y = 0
var $bullet_state = 0;0 = not  fired, 1 = fired, 2 = exploding
var $explode_time = 0

const $proj_length = 8
var $proj_state1 = 0
var $proj_state2 = 0
var $proj_x1 = 0
var $proj_x2 = 0
var $proj_y1 = 0
var $proj_y2 = 0
var $proj_next = 0
var $proj_anim1 = 0
var $proj_anim2 = 0

var $lose_position = 0
var $player_y = 0

var $death_animation = -1

var $level_animation = -1

var $shot_counter = 0

include "destructables.xc"

;Drawing functions start here
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

;Draws the enemy based on its state
function @_draw_enemy($enemy:text)
	var $x = $enemy.pos:number
	var $actual_row = $enemy.row + $down_moves
	var $y = $actual_row * $row_size + $enemy_height_offset
	var $state = $enemy.state
	var $anim_state = $state == 2
	if $state == 1 || $state == 2
		if $enemy.row == 0
			@sprite_draw_invader_1($x, $y,$anim_state, white)
		elseif $enemy.row == 1 || $enemy.row == 2
			@sprite_draw_invader_2($x, $y,$anim_state, white)
		elseif $enemy.row == 3 || $enemy.row == 4
			@sprite_draw_invader_3($x,$y,$anim_state, white)
	elseif $state >= 3
		@sprite_draw_explosion($x, $y, orange)

;Draws the entire enemy field
function @_draw_enemies()
	var $count = size($states)
	repeat $count ($i)
		var $state = $states.$i
		@_draw_enemy($state)

;Draws the enemy projectiles
function @_draw_projectiles()
	if $proj_state1
		$proj_anim1 += 1
		if $proj_anim1 >= 4
			$proj_anim1 = 0
		draw_line($proj_x1,$proj_y1,$proj_x1, $proj_y1 - $proj_length, yellow)
		
		var $h_pos = ($proj_anim1 / 4) * $proj_length
		draw_line($proj_x1-1,$proj_y1 - $h_pos,$proj_x1+2, $proj_y1 - $h_pos, yellow)
	if $proj_state2
		$proj_anim2 += 1
		if $proj_anim2 >= 6
			$proj_anim2 = 0
		var $x = 0
		var $y = -$proj_anim2
		var $dir = 1
		while 1
			$y += 1
			$x += $dir
			if $x >= 2
				$dir = -1
			if $x < 1
				$dir = 1
			if $y >= 0
				draw_point(($proj_x2 + $x) - 1,$proj_y2 + $y, yellow)
				draw_point(($proj_x2 + $x) - 1,$proj_y2 + $y - 1, yellow);Just make it a bit thicker for us amd users :(
			if $y >= $proj_length
				break

;Draws the player bullet
function @_draw_bullet()
	if $bullet_state == 1
		draw_line($bullet_x,$bullet_y,$bullet_x, $bullet_y + 8, red)
		draw_point($bullet_x+1,$bullet_y+8,orange)
		draw_point($bullet_x-1,$bullet_y+8,orange)
	elseif $bullet_state == 2



;Gameplay logic starts here
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

;private function
;use setup_game to prepare the game for play
;Sets all values that matter to their default value
function @_restart_field()
	$last_fire_button = 1;Prevent premature bullet fires
	$death_animation = -1
	$down_moves = 0
	$states.clear()
	$direction = 0
	$bullet_state = 0
	$ufo_state = 0
	$shot_counter = 0
	var $enemy_count = $enemy_columns * 5
	$move_index = $enemy_count - 1
	var $offset = (screen_w * 0.5) - ($enemy_columns * $column_size * 0.5)
	
	;If an enemy reaches this position it's GG
	$lose_position = $destructable_ypos
	$player_y = screen_h - 15
	
	$proj_next = $projectile_fire_rate
	
	@init_destructables()
	
	repeat $enemy_count ($i)
		var $row = floor($i / $enemy_columns)
		var $pos = (($i - ($row * $enemy_columns)) * $column_size) + $offset
		var $enemy = ".state{1}.pos{"&$pos:text&"}.row{"&$row:text&"}"
		
		$states.append($enemy)

;Sets everything to default, including the score etc
function @setup_game()
	$current_score = 0
	$player_pos = screen_w * 0.5
	$lives = 3
	$level = 1
	
	var $high_score_info = @get_highest_score()
	$highest_score = $high_score_info.score:number
	$player_to_beat = $high_score_info.name
	
	@_restart_field()


;private function
;Called when all lives have been depleted and death animation has played
function @_game_over()
	var $is_top_score = @check_score_is_top()
	if $is_top_score
		@goto_name_input()
	else
		@return_to_title()

;private function
;fires a projectile from the enemy specified by the index into the states array
function @_fire_projectile($index:number)
	;Find the bottom row first
	var $next_index = $index
	var $enemy = ""
	var $count = size($states)
	while $next_index < $count
		var $e = $states.$next_index
		if $e.state == 1 || $e.state == 2
			$enemy = $e
		$next_index += $enemy_columns
	
	var $x = $enemy.pos:number
	var $actual_row = $enemy.row + $down_moves
	var $y = $actual_row * $row_size + $enemy_height_offset
	if $proj_state1 == 0
		$proj_state1 = 1
		$proj_x1 = $x
		$proj_y1 = $y
	elseif $proj_state2 == 0
		$proj_state2 = 1
		$proj_x2 = $x
		$proj_y2 = $y

;private function
;Attempts to move this enemy, assumes the enemy is not dead. Returns 1 if the enemy moved, 0 if not.
function @_move_enemy($enemy:text):number
	if $enemy.state >= 3 + $explode_frames
		$enemy.state = 0
		$states.$move_index = $enemy
		return 0
	elseif $enemy.state >= 3
		$enemy.state += 1
		$states.$move_index = $enemy
		return 0
	else
		var $row = $enemy.row:number
		var $y_position = (($row + $down_moves) * $row_size) + $enemy_height_offset
		
		;Player has died next frame we'll go into death animation
		if $y_position >= $lose_position
			$death_animation = 0
		if $enemy.state == 1
			$enemy.state = 2
		elseif $enemy.state == 2
			$enemy.state = 1
		var $cpos = $enemy.pos:number
		if $direction == 0
			$enemy.pos = $cpos + $move_amount
		else
			$enemy.pos = $cpos - $move_amount
		if $enemy.pos < $game_area_limit || $enemy.pos > screen_w - $game_area_limit
			$direction = !$direction
			$down_moves += 1
			if $direction == 0
				$enemy.pos = $cpos + $move_amount
			else
				$enemy.pos = $cpos - $move_amount
				
		;Check if we should fire a projectile
		$proj_next -= 1
		if $proj_next <= 0
			;Fire projectile
			$proj_next = $projectile_fire_rate
			@_fire_projectile($move_index)
			
	$states.$move_index = $enemy
	return 1


;private function
;Handles both collision with bullet only (player detection is during move_enemy)
function @_enemy_collision()
	if $bullet_state != 1
		return;Only need to check if there's a bullet
	;Check what row the bullet is in, if any
	var $bullet_row = floor(($bullet_y - $enemy_height_offset) / $row_size) - $down_moves
	if $bullet_row < 0 || $bullet_row >= 5
		return
	
	var $hit_enemy = -1
	repeat $column_size ($i)
		var $index = $i + $bullet_row * $enemy_columns
		if $index < 0 || $index >= size($states)
			continue
		var $enemy = $states.$index
		if $enemy.state >= 3 || $enemy.state == 0
			continue
		var $offset_x = abs($enemy.pos - $bullet_x)
		if $offset_x <= $enemy_size
			$hit_enemy = $index
			break
			
	if $hit_enemy != -1
		var $enemy = $states.$hit_enemy
		var $row = $enemy.row:number
		$enemy.state = 3
		$bullet_state = 2
		@play_explosion_sfx()
		$states.$hit_enemy = $enemy
		print ($row_scores.$row)
		$current_score += $level * $row_scores.$row * 10

;private function
;Player has hit space to fire a bullet
function @_player_fire()
	$bullet_x = $player_pos
	$bullet_y = screen_h - 15
	$bullet_state = 1
	$shot_counter += 1

;private function
;A bullet has hit the UFO provide some score
function @_ufo_hit()
	$ufo_state = 0
	;Award bonus points based on the original space invaders
	var $bonus = $shot_counter - 23
	if $bonus % 15 == 0
		$current_score += 300
	else
		$current_Score += random(50,150)

;private function
;Checks if the ufo should be spawned
function @_check_to_spawn_ufo($skipped_moves:number)
	var $r = random(0, $enemy_columns * 5)
	var $spawn_accept = $skipped_moves
	if $r < $spawn_accept
		if random < $ufo_chance_modifier
			$ufo_state = 1
			$ufo_pos = 0

;private function
;Updates the ufo state or spawns if necessary
function @_ufo_update($skipped_moves:number)
	if $ufo_state == 0
		@_check_to_spawn_ufo($skipped_moves)
	if $ufo_state == 1
		$ufo_pos += delta_time * $ufo_speed
		if $ufo_pos > screen_w
			$ufo_state = 0

;private function
;Updates the player bullet, handles collision with destructables and ufo
function @_update_bullet()
	if $bullet_state == 1
		@play_bullet_sfx()
		$bullet_y -= delta_time * $bullet_speed
		if $bullet_y < 12
			$bullet_state = 2
			$explode_time = 0
			if $ufo_state == 1 && abs($ufo_pos - $bullet_x) < $ufo_hit_width
				@_ufo_hit()
		else
			var $hit = @do_destruct_collision($bullet_x, $bullet_y)
			if $hit == 1
				$bullet_state = 2
				$explode_time = 0
	elseif $bullet_state == 2
		$explode_time += delta_time
		if $explode_time > $bullet_explode_time
			$bullet_state = 0

;Checks if this projectile would be hitting the player assuming it's already at the correct Y position
function @_check_projectile_hit($proj_x:number)
	var $dist = abs($proj_x - $player_pos)
	if $dist < $player_width
		$death_animation = 0


;private function
;Moves the enemy projectils and checks their collions
function @_update_enemy_projectiles();They're not bullets, they're projectiles ;)
	var $hit = 0
	if $proj_state1
		$proj_y1 += 1
		if $proj_y1 >= $player_y
			@_check_projectile_hit($proj_x1)
			$proj_state1 = 0
		$hit = @do_destruct_collision($proj_x1, $proj_y1)
		if $hit
			$proj_state1 = 0
	if $proj_state2
		$proj_y2 += 1
		if $proj_y2 > $player_y
			@_check_projectile_hit($proj_x2)
			$proj_state2 = 0
		$hit = @do_destruct_collision($proj_x2, $proj_y2)
		if $hit
			$proj_state2 = 0


;private function
;Player is not dead, lets play
function @_normal_play()
	var $moves = 0;Amount of moves simulate including skipped moves because of dead or exploding enemies
	var $move_next = 1
	while $move_next
		$moves += 1
		if $moves > size($states)
			$level += 1
			$level_animation = 0
			@_restart_field()
		var $enemy = $states.$move_index
		if $enemy.state != 0;Dead move on
			$move_next = !@_move_enemy($enemy)
		$move_index -= 1
		if $move_index < 0
			$move_index = size($states) - 1
			@play_step_sfx()
	$player_pos = clamp($player_pos + (input_number(10,2) * delta_time * 75),$game_area_limit,screen_w - $game_area_limit)
	var $fire_button = input_number(10,3) == 1 && $bullet_state == 0
	if $fire_button && !$last_fire_button
		@_player_fire()
	$last_fire_button = $fire_button
	
	@_update_bullet()
	@_enemy_collision()
	@_update_enemy_projectiles()
	@_ufo_update($moves)

;private function
;Player is dead :(
function @_death_sequence()
	$death_animation += delta_time
	if $death_animation > $death_animation_length
		$death_animation = -1
		$lives -= 1
		if $lives <= 0
			@_game_over()
		@_restart_field()

;private function
;Moves and shows the "Level x" on level transitions
function @_level_animation()
	var $level_trans_text = "Level " & $level:text
	var $text_size = size($level_trans_text) * char_w
	var $y_pos = $level_animation / ($level_transition_time * 0.25);Slide into the middle
	if $y_pos > 3
		$y_pos -= 3
		$y_pos = 1 - $y_pos
	write((screen_w * 0.5) - ($text_size * 0.5), (clamp($y_pos,0,1) * 0.5 * screen_h) - (char_h * 0.5),white,$level_trans_text)
	$level_animation += delta_time
	if $level_animation > $level_transition_time
		$level_animation = -1

;private function
;Draws the current play-field
function @_draw_field()
	;Score screen at top
	write(1,0,white,"Score: " & $current_score:text)
	var $best_text = "Best: " & $player_to_beat & " with " & $highest_score:text
	write(screen_w - size($best_text) * char_w,0,gray,$best_text)
	
	;Draw lives and life icons (which is just the players.. tank?)
	draw_line(0,screen_h - 11,screen_w, screen_h - 11, white)
	write(1,screen_h - char_h, white, "Lives: " & $lives:text)
	var $life_after = $lives - 1
	repeat $life_after  ($i)
		@sprite_draw_player(60 + $i * 12, screen_h - 4, green)
	
	@_draw_bullet()
	;During the death sequence the player should just be an explosion
	if $death_animation == -1
		@sprite_draw_player($player_pos,$player_y, green)
	else
		@sprite_draw_explosion($player_pos,$player_y, red)
	@_draw_enemies()
	@_draw_projectiles()
	@draw_destructables()
	
	if $ufo_state == 1
		@sprite_draw_invader_ufo($ufo_pos, $ufo_ypos, red)
		

;Called in the update when the game is running, handles everything including logic and drawing
function @play_game()
	blank(black);Blank this mofo, we're just gonna draw everything cause I don't have time for optimization

	;Update logic
	if $death_animation == -1 && $level_animation == -1;lez getsa killin aliens
		@_normal_play()
		
	if $death_animation != -1;G_G
		@_death_sequence()
	if $level_animation != -1;Level up boiiii
		@_level_animation()
		return;The level animation does not draw the play field
	
	@_draw_field()
